Our people went *All in* for a good cause with Splash for Cash – a global fundraising event that brought colleagues across Super Group together in support of charities making a difference around the world.


Across our offices, members of our leadership team stepped up to face a variety of water-themed challenges, with colleagues donating to see them take the plunge.


Together, **we raised an incredible £6,500** , supporting charities including **WaterAid, Intaka Nature Reserve and Earthlife Africa** .


It was a brilliant example of what can happen when our global community comes together. We gathered, we laughed and we walked away with some epic memories – all while raising vital funds for causes that matter.


A huge thank you to everyone who donated, volunteered or got involved and to our leaders for being such good sports.


This is Super Group Cares in action: bringing our people together, supporting our communities and going *All in* to make a difference.
